    Editor’s Pick

      Tournament Social Banner

      PNG · 898 × 620 px

      Pick the tournament type, fill in the prize and entry details, and download. Special, Monthly, Weekly and Daily banners also give you the matching Last Chance banner as a second download.

      Tournament

      Prize & game

      $

      The $ is added for you. Leave the value empty or 0 to hide it. The coin value shows as “+ [coin value] Coins Tournament”; leave it empty to hide that line.

      Game icon

      Fits a 325 × 325 px area on the right.

      Daily general

      Shown as “of [month]”. Preset to next month.

      Game frames

      Drop images on a frame, or several at once to fill the empty ones. Drag a frame onto another to swap them. Empty frames show the brand gradient.

      Entry

      0 shows “Free entry, no buy-in”. Any other amount shows “Entry [amount] Coins”.
